label: Steps shortly after an input digit 0 (original phase / delimiter)
explanation: Fires during the original-token phase and on <DEL> in the 1-3 steps after the digit 0 was input. It does not fire on the 0 itself, and it is almost silent in the copy phase (0.8% of mass). Activation is largest on the step right after the 0 (prev_tok=0: rate 0.50, 49% of mass, 78% of top-quartile steps) and fades over the next two or three steps. The top examples are 0 0 r, where the 0 followed by r peaks. A weaker version fires after other tokens, mostly prev_tok b (rate 0.16), and there is a low-level background on early original steps with no 0, which makes up most of the lowest-quartile misses. On dev, a 0 in the last 3 inputs gives F1 0.64 and mass recall 0.79; requiring only the previous step gives precision 0.84 and mass recall 0.49.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
